name: 25411 · Berkeley Spgs, WV
findings: ZIP 25411 (Berkeley Spgs) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25411 (Berkeley Spgs) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 25411 (Berkeley Spgs) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
